result.topic_en: Calculations dated (November?) 1859 expressing $\Pi(s/2-1)\zeta(s)$ through an integral over the theta function $\sqrt{2K/\pi}$ in the nome $q$, and transforming it with elliptic integrals $K, K'$ and moduli $k, k'$ (Legendre relation, derivatives with respect to $\log q$).
result.transcription:
[?]vember 1859.
$\zeta(s) = \sum \frac{1}{n^s} = \prod \frac{1}{(1-\frac{1}{p^s})}$ \quad $\int_0^\infty e^{-nnx} x^{\frac{s}{2}-1} \partial x = \frac{\Pi(\frac{s}{2}-1)}{n^s}$
$\Pi(\frac{s}{2}-1) [?] = \int_0^\infty \frac{\sqrt{\frac{2K}{\pi}}-1}{2} (-\log q)^{\frac{s}{2}-1} \partial(-\log q)$
$= \frac{1}{s}\int_0^\infty \frac{\partial \sqrt{\frac{2K}{\pi}}}{\partial \log q} (-\log q)^{\frac{s}{2}} \partial(-\log q)$
$= \frac{1}{s}\,\frac{2}{s-1}\int_0^\infty \frac{\partial (-\log q)^{\frac{3}{2}} \frac{\partial\sqrt{\frac{2K}{\pi}}}{\partial \log q}}{\partial \log q} (-\log q)^{\frac{s-1}{2}} \partial(-\log q)$
$k(1-k^2)\left(K\frac{\partial K'}{\partial k} - K'\frac{\partial K}{\partial k}\right) = -\frac{\pi}{2}$ \quad $kk'\frac{\partial \log q}{\partial \log k} = \frac{\pi\pi}{2KK}$ \quad $\frac{\partial \log k}{\partial \log q} = 2\left(\frac{k'K}{\pi}\right)^2$ \quad $\frac{\partial \log k'}{\partial \log q} = -2\left(\frac{kK}{\pi}\right)^2$
$(-\log q)^{\frac{3}{2}}\frac{\partial \sqrt{\frac{2K}{\pi}}}{\partial \log q} = \sqrt{\frac{2}{\pi}}\;\frac{1}{2} K^{-\frac{1}{2}} \frac{\partial K}{\partial \log k}\, 2\left(\frac{k'K}{\pi}\right)^2 \left(\pi\frac{K'}{K}\right)^{\frac{3}{2}}$
$= \sqrt{2}\,\frac{\partial K}{\partial \log k}\,\frac{k'k'K'^{\frac{3}{2}}}{\pi}$ \quad\quad $\frac{\partial\, k k' k' \frac{\partial K}{\partial k}}{\partial \log k} = kkK$
$\frac{\partial (-\log q)^{\frac{3}{2}}\frac{\partial\sqrt{\frac{2K}{\pi}}}{\partial \log q}}{\partial \log q} = \sqrt{2}\,\frac{kkK}{\pi} K'^{\frac{3}{2}}\, 2\left(\frac{k'K}{\pi}\right)^2 + \sqrt{2}\,\frac{k'k'}{\pi}\frac{\partial K}{\partial \log k}\,\frac{3}{2}K'^{\frac{1}{2}}\frac{\partial K'}{\partial \log k'}\cdot -2\left(\frac{kK}{\pi}\right)^2$
$\pi^{-\frac{s}{2}}\zeta(s)\,\Pi(\frac{s}{2}-1) = \int_{-\infty}^{\infty} kkk'k' [-\left(\frac{4KK'}{\pi\pi}\right)-] \left(\frac{KK'}{\pi\pi}\right)^{\frac{9}{4}} \left(1 - \frac{3}{2}\frac{\partial \log K}{\partial \log k'}\frac{\partial \log K'}{\partial \log k}\right) \left(\frac{K'}{K}\right)^{\frac{s}{2}-\frac{1}{4}} \partial \log \frac{K'}{K}\cdot\frac{\pi\pi}{4s(s-1)}$

methods.what: Dirichlet series and Euler product for zeta
Mellin integral representation via theta function $\sqrt{2K/\pi}$ in the nome
Repeated integration by parts producing factors 1/s and 2/(s-1)
Legendre relation for complete elliptic integrals (Wronskian form)
Derivatives of the modulus with respect to log of the nome
